stories.title: Flintshire forecast to hit 30C as third heatwave of the year builds
stories.summary: Flintshire is forecast to hit 30C this week, as the third heatwave of the year builds across the UK. The latest forecast for Hawarden shows temperatures climbing from 24C on Monday to a peak of 30C on Friday, before easing back to 27C over the weekend.
